title: The Crucial Function of Drain Traps
description: Drain traps are an essential component of every plumbing fixture connection, designed with a deliberate dip that holds a standing volume of water. This water seal acts as an invisible barrier preventing sewer gases, foul odors, and harmful bacteria from entering living and working spaces through the fixture opening. Maintaining this seal relies on proper venting; without adequate air intake, pressure fluctuations can siphon the water out of the trap entirely. Understanding how traps function helps technicians troubleshoot intermittent odor complaints and ensure healthy indoor air quality.
caption:
The Crucial Function of Drain Traps

Drain traps are an essential component of every plumbing fixture connection, designed with a deliberate dip that holds a standing volume of water. This water seal acts as an invisible barrier preventing sewer gases, foul odors, and harmful bacteria from entering living and working spaces through the fixture opening. Maintaining this seal relies on proper venting; without adequate air intake, pressure fluctuations can siphon the water out of the trap entirely. Understanding how traps function helps technicians troubleshoot intermittent odor complaints and ensure healthy indoor air quality.
